title: Raccoon Island Boat Tour - Indian Creek, Sanbar and Raccoons
blurb:
Embark on an unforgettable 3-hour boat tour to Raccoon Island! 

We'll visit Indian Creek, an upscale residential area with luxurious waterfront homes and mansions owned by celebrities and billionaires like Tom Brady, Julio Iglesias, Ivanka Trump.

Next, we'll head to Haulover Sandbar, a popular local spot for boaters. The crystal clear water and stunning views will make this a memorable experience for you!

After, we'll move on to our final destination of the day: Raccoon Island! 

This hidden gem of an uninhabited island offers a leisurely beach walk, natural beauty, and wildlife observation, including its famous raccoons.

So come aboard and let us show you a side of Miami that most people never get to see!
